title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1376: Dont offend women (1)

section.p: Su Yu could feel his danger sense slowly fading away.

He did not dare to think too much as he was afraid that his thoughts would be sensed by someone. He didn’t even dare to think of the fact that he was Su Yu. Like everyone else, he was fully focused on the distant gate.
It was massive. White-jade in color, it looked slightly transparent.
Luminous Domain (Xing Yu).
Was that a name? Or was that a title?

This mansion seemed to have some connections to the Human Emperor. Or to be precise, this could very well be the location of the so-called Myriad Race Assembly. According to the old turtle, the time projections of the ancient experts could be found on the ninth level.
The white-jade gate was pulsing slightly, as though it was breathing. Each time it pulsed, a burst of source qi would ripple out in all directions. It felt as though the gate was alive.
“How beautiful.”

Those were not Su Yu’s words. Rather, they were the words of a beautiful humanoid fish nearby. The humanoid fish had a pleasant voice, but one should refrain from looking at the head of the fish as that would ruin the beautiful image left by the voice of the fish.

The humanoid form was quite popular among many races. That was mainly because many of the powerful races, such as the human, immortal, divine, and devil races were all humanoid races. Thus, their form was akin to a trend everyone pursued. As a result of different beauty standards across the various races, numerous unique humanoid forms had been created in the Myriad Realms.

Such was the case for the humanoid fish, who had maintained the head of a fish on a humanoid body. That was most likely a deliberate choice since at the Cloudbreach Realm, one should be able to perform a full transformation.
“Beautiful?”

A ferocious middle-aged man with the tail of a wolf said, “You’re saying that because you have no idea how many experts have died in there. Many years ago, a race tried to attack and force this gate open before it was time. Ultimately, that entire race went extinct. That was a powerful race with a large number of experts. Yet they had gone extinct assaulting this gate.”
Was that true? Su Yu had never heard of that. Curious, he smiled and asked, “Is that so? My race is unaware of that. Which race was that?”

When the wolf-tailed man noticed that many people were looking at him, he said, “Sure enough, many have forgotten about this. That’s understandable. The major races are deliberately hiding this piece of history to encourage the other races to do the same foolish thing. Many years ago, there was a race known as the space devourer race. They consumed space for living, and they were extremely powerful. This was also an ancient race. For some reason, they made the stupid choice of assaulting this gate. Ultimately, they went extinct.”

After a short pause, he continued, “There is a constant stream of people trying to sneak through this gate all the time. None of them survived. This gate will only open when a tide is imminent. At any other time, no living being can enter.”

Su Yu nodded. He was aware of that. Entry was impossible at any other time as the tunnels leading inside the mansion were still sealed. Without the tunnels, going through the white-jade gate would only result in death.
Suddenly, his expression changed.
The same was happening to everyone around him.

A massive palm was dropping down upon the humans from the sky. At the same time, a shining saber rose into the sky. At the exact moment, a jade sword shot out of thin air before flying toward the human encampment.
The sword had appeared out of nowhere, as though it had been manifested by timespace itself.

In the human encampment, Great Xia King roared with fury and drew his saber. Ignoring the palm and the jade sword, he swung his saber at the immortal encampment. At the same time, a tear was ripped open midair. Someone stepped out of the opening before shooting toward the divine encampment.
Countless armors burst apart at the same time.

In the human encampment, numerous bloody scars appeared on Bai Junsheng’s body. This was merely the effect of the killing intent from the sword. The jade sword itself had yet to arrive. Beside him, Zhu Tianfang roared and manifested a character. An entire chunk of space was frozen as Zhu Tianfang shifted everyone around him away.
Everything had happened so suddenly.
Meanwhile, Great Xia King and Great Zhou King continued attacking the immortal and divine encampments. Before anyone knew it, space started collapsing all over the two encampments.
Moments later, numerous Invincibles appeared in the sky. One of them demanded, “What are you doing? Stop!”
“Are you trying to start a war now?’
“Humans, stop!”
Numerous shouts rang out.
One Invincible after another appeared around Great Xia King and Great Zhou King.
With a smile, Great Zhou King took a few steps back before vanishing with a flicker.

As for Great Xia King, he looked around with a cold expression. His swept his gaze over Dao King, the white-haired divine king, and the Invincibles around him before saying, “Very well. Wait and see.”
Leaving those words behind, he vanished with a flicker.
Silence returned.
Dao King and the white-haired divine king appeared indifferent. They said nothing, but they were feeling quite doubtful. So it wasn’t Bai Junsheng? Was it Wu Qi or one of the girls instead?

That assault earlier had pierced through Bai Junsheng’s body. They could clearly see how weak his body was. Even his bones were revealed for a split second. No matter how heavy Su Yu’s injuries were, his body wouldn’t be so weak.
Meanwhile, Bai Junsheng was dripping with cold sweat.
He was rejoicing in the fact that he had listened to Su Yu. Right after joining up with the other humans, he had stuck close to Zhu Tianfang. He would have died otherwise.
Surviving would be impossible.

Zhu Tianfang was not weak. Even among Invincibles, he was considered quite strong. He had the history of fighting an Invincible without losing over a hundred years ago. After so long, he had most certainly grown even stronger than before. Thus, even with the attacks of two Invincibles coming his way, he was still able to use his space manipulation to take everyone away from danger.
At the moment, he had a solemn expression.
He glanced at Bai Junsheng and sent a voice transmission, “They are suspecting that you’re Su Yu. You need to watch your back. I suggest that you refrain from entering the mansion this time.”
Bai Junsheng had requested his protection right after arriving.

He understood how serious things were right after hearing Bai Junsheng’s explanation. However, he had not imagined that the two Invincibles would be brash enough to attack directly. If Great Xia King and Great Zhou King had not attacked their encampments directly, provoking the interference of the other Invincibles, the two might not have stopped attacking.
This was too dangerous. If he had been the only Invincible present earlier, he would have failed to protect Bai Junsheng.
Far away, Su Yu’s heart was thumping madly.
Bai Junsheng! One of the identities he had considered using.
Damn it!
Sure enough, the humans were being targeted.

The myriad races would have investigated more before attacking instead of going straight for the kill otherwise. If he had proceeded with his initial plan to take Bai Junsheng’s identity, he would have been exposed immediately. Following that, the various experts would attack and end his life.
Dao King and the others had stopped not because they were afraid of the humans. Rather, they had stopped because it was clear this was the real Bai Junsheng. The injuries on his body made that clear.
Bai Junsheng was simply not worth a war with the human race. What even was the point of killing him?

They wanted to kill Su Yu. They were willing to accept a war with the human race if it meant the death of Su Yu. In any case, the immortal, devil, and divine races had reached a consensus on this. Thus, a war with the human race wasn’t a big deal at the moment.
Previously, the divine and devil races had held back against humanity because the immortal race had been unwilling to adopt a clear stance when it concerned humanity.
Of course, the devil race had now replaced the immortal race as the race without a clear stance concerning humanity.
Due to the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s injuries, the devils had pulled back the scope of their operations lately. A devil Invincible would have joined the attack against Bai Junsheng as well, otherwise.
Su Yu was greatly alarmed.
Damn it!
These bastards were too determined to kill him.
Suddenly, his tribulation character started pulsing again. He hurriedly calmed himself and recited something else in his mind, “So strong. Too strong. I want to be so strong as well…”
The two eyes continued scanning all the minor race experts gathered in the area. Numerous scenes played in the two eyes. In the two eyes, each individual would be split into three.
Past, present, and future.
However, the two eyes were only performing a rough inspection of the crowd. There were too many people for them to perform a more detailed inspection.
Suddenly, Dao King sent a palm attack toward a specific spot. With a rumble, space collapsed while a Sunmoon roared before transforming into a massive black bear.
The transformation had barely been completed when the palm struck and killed the black bear.
A moon dropped from the sky.

Silence descended while countless people started thinking of fleeing. Just then, Dao King’s voice rang out, “I’m not killing for no reason. That is Blackwind of the bear race. Once, he slaughtered an entire unit of immortal soldiers. He is a wanted criminal.”
With a complicated expression, an Invincible said, “Yes. Blackwind is a traitor of my race. Thank you, Dao King, for removing the traitor for us.”
Blackwind was indeed wanted by the immortals. Surprisingly, he had hidden among the crowd to enter the mansion. And even more surprisingly, Dao King had discovered him and killed him with a slap.
Blackwind had concealed himself decently, but he had failed to hide from Dao King. A Sunmoon had died before the mansion was even open.
Human encampment.
Great Xia King glanced at Dao King with a pensive look.
Beside him, Great Zhou King appeared with a flicker before saying, “Daofuse eyes.”
Great Xia King nodded. He lightly stroked the saber hanging from his waist and said, “Will he act personally if his Daofuse eyes are destroyed?”

“It’s too hard.” Great Zhou King looked around and said, “Dao King is weaker than you, but it won’t be easy to defeat him. Eliminating the Daofuse eyes he’s holding will be even harder. In a prolonged battle, you risk getting yourself encircled and killed instead.”
Hearing that, Great Xia King pulled his hand away from his saber and said, “Even the Daofuse eyes are out. Are they looking for Su Yu?”
“Most likely.” Great Zhou King said, “Tiangu has personally issued the kill order. The immortals will naturally spare no effort for this. They probably believe that Su Yu has arrived.”
They all knew that the immortals and divines were doing this to look for Su Yu. It wouldn’t be wise for Su Yu to leave his ancient city. Things were getting troublesome.
